sources.title: Qwen
sources.snippet: Qwen is an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models. It's free to use, open to all, and ready to help with creativity, collaboration, and endless possibilities.

sources.title: Qwen - lablab.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2. Qwen-Image-2. is a 7B-parameter image generation model supporting photorealism, professional typography, and unified generation-editing workflows, released in February 2026. Qwen-MT Qwen-MT is a translation model covering 92 major languages and dialects, reaching over 95% of the global population.
